integrity: All propositions are supported by the explicit all-length symbolic proof; computational finite tests are reported at actual ranges, not treated as proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Theorem covers only noncyclic binary alternating words; broader alphabets and general source words are not classified. Unindexed priority risk remains. Finite verification supplements an analytic proof.
title: Minimal absent subsequences of alternating binary words: an exact bivariate generating function
